title: 中国对欧盟顺差创纪录：美国调查产能过剩，关税风险逼近？
speaker: Min Min Lo

segments.en: When you look at the trade surpluses that China runs with the EU, it is at a new record right now.
segments.zh: 中国对欧盟的贸易顺差目前处于历史新高。

segments.en: And of course don't forget the U.S. is also still investigating this probe into Chinese overcapacity and that could also lead to more tariffs as well.
segments.zh: 别忘了美国也仍在调查中国产能过剩问题，可能导致更多关税。

segments.en: Now this U.S. ban on some new robots and power inverters. I think those are stocks we're also tracking in the session today. What's that about?
segments.zh: 现在美国禁止某些新型机器人和电源逆变器。这些也是我们今天关注的板块。

segments.en: Yeah, so the U.S. has decided to ban some of these new robots, particularly humanoid robots and quadrupeds as well as power inverters.
segments.zh: 美国决定禁止某些新型机器人，特别是人形机器人和四足机器人，以及电源逆变器。
